title: Permission is exact object and method authority
summary: PermissionAuthority evaluates a PermissionRequest bound to principal, exact object identity, object class, method, Security Effect disposition, Security Effect policy identity, trace identity, and retained constraints.
invariants: Permission is exact subject x object x method authority, not class-wide authority unless policy deliberately uses a wildcard object selector.
PermissionRequest cannot be sealed without Security Effect evidence.
Security Effect evidence must be bound to the same principal, exact object id, and method.
Same-class different-object access remains denied unless explicitly authorized.
Default action is DENY and DENY wins equal-priority mixed-action ties.

provenance.claim: Permission is exact protected-operation authority bound to principal, exact object, method and Security Effect evidence; Security Manager remains enforcement.
PermissionRequest binds exact object/method and refuses Security Effect evidence for a different principal, object, or method.
PermissionAuthority evaluates sealed/effective policy, optional attribution subject binding, deterministic rule selection and signed decision envelope.
